```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)

# Load your data here
CUHB_phenotypes <- read_csv("CUHB_phenotypes.csv")

#changing the name of the columns 

library(dplyr)

CUHB_phenotypes <- CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  rename(DON_content = `FHB DON content - ppm|CO_321:0001154`, FHB_incidence = `FHB incidence - %|CO_321:0001149`, disease_index = `FHB disease index - %|CO_321:0501030`, FHB_severity = `FHB severity - %|CO_321:0001440`)
```

## Overview

- 374 unique accessions
- Field years: 2013–2016, 2020–2026
- Traits: FHB incidence (%), severity (%), incidence × severity index (%)
- DON (ppm) available for a subset of years (2021, 2024, 2025)
- Tim had said that the values on the csv file were averages, but some germplasms had multiple reps per year while others had only 1 in the entire duration of study.

## Data Coverage (FHB DON content)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Heatmap of which accessions have data in which years
# Swap DON for whichever trait, or facet across traits
CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  group_by(germplasmName) %>%
  summarise(n_years_DON = sum(!is.na(DON_content))) %>%
  count(n_years_DON) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_years_DON))
```

## Accession Consistency Across Years

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

don_means <- CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  group_by(germplasmName) %>%
  summarise(mean_DON = mean(DON_content, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_years = sum(!is.na(DON_content)))

top_10_names <- don_means %>%
  filter(n_years >= 3) %>%
  arrange(mean_DON) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_10_data <- CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  filter(germplasmName %in% top_10_names$germplasmName)

top_10_data <- top_10_data %>%
  group_by(germplasmName, studyYear) %>%
  summarise(DON = mean(DON_content, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# top_10_data should already be built from your earlier filtering steps
ggplot(top_10_data, aes(x = studyYear, y = DON, group = germplasmName, color = germplasmName)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "DON Content Across Years — 10 Lowest-Mean Accessions",
       x = "Year", y = "DON (ppm)")
```

## Disease index consistency across years

```{r}
# Step 1: means and coverage
index_means <- CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  group_by(germplasmName) %>%
  summarise(mean_Index = mean(disease_index, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_years = sum(!is.na(disease_index)))

# Step 2: top 10 lowest (most resistant)
top_10_index_names <- index_means %>%
  filter(n_years >= 3) %>%
  arrange(mean_Index) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

# Step 3: filter full dataset to those accessions
top_10_index_data <- CUHB_phenotypes %>%
  filter(germplasmName %in% top_10_index_names$germplasmName)

# Step 4: collapse to one value per accession-year
top_10_index_data <- top_10_index_data %>%
  group_by(germplasmName, studyYear) %>%
  summarise(Index = mean(disease_index, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
ggplot(top_10_index_data, aes(x = studyYear, y = Index, group = germplasmName, color = germplasmName)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Index Across Years — 10 Lowest-Mean Accessions",
       x = "Year", y = "Index (%)")
```
